bar.name: M48's bar: the adapted small embedder
bar.passes: the paired nDCG@10 delta of hybrid@bge-small-marginmse against hybrid@bge-small has a 95% interval whose lower end is strictly above zero (the stored 4-decimal lower end > 0; a stored 0.0 is not above zero) on fixture v1's held-out half (68 questions) AND on BEIR SciFact test (300) AND on BEIR FiQA test (648)
bar.one_seed: the verdict is read on seed 0 alone, because what would be served is one checkpoint; seeds 1 and 2 are reported beside it
bar.parent_rule: hybrid@bge-small recomputed in the same run, on the same device, from the same code path; on BEIR its document matrix is computed in that run, never read from the shared cache
bar.hybrid: BM25 plus the embedder fused by RRF, k = 60, equal weights, exactly as the committed hybrid@bge-small rows build it; fixture: the harness settings (retrieve_k 50, router, reranker and staleness off, mtimes from the manifest); BEIR: the runner's hybrid@bge-small config with the embedder swapped
bar.held_out: fixture v1: the test half of app.eval.rerank_arms.split_questions; no choice of any kind is made on the tune half, whose rows and the all-136 rows are reported beside it; BEIR: the test split
bar.which_run: the first complete eval run per dataset at the C3 (manifest) commit; a re-run for any reason goes to <name>_rerun<k>.json and never replaces it; a defect found later is recorded beside the first run's verdict
bar.interval: percentile bootstrap over queries, paired, 2000 resamples, seed 0 (app/eval/stats.py); one index matrix per dataset and scope, shared by every row

outcomes.does not pass: any measured leg not above zero; a leg whose upper end is below zero is also a recorded loss
outcomes.open: a leg is not measured and no measured leg fails; an open bar is not passed
outcomes.not run: the bar row was not trained by the cutoff; no other arm is read in its place

bar.multiple_testing: one pre-declared conjunctive test (intersection-union): three two-sided 95% intervals whose lower ends must all be above zero give an overall one-sided level of at most 2.5%; every other delta is descriptive and labelled exploratory
secondary: dense@bge-small-marginmse (fixture dense_only@) against the base dense row on the same three datasets
if its arm runs, the same bar form for hybrid@bge-base-marginmse against hybrid@bge-base
the mean delta over the bar recipe's seeds that ran (0 to 2), beside the seed-0 verdict
bar.llm_judge: no metric uses an LLM judge; the teacher's logits are training targets and the validation loss only

adapted_embedders.bar_outcome_rule: this file holds one leg of the bar (bar_leg, written after its rows); the bar's outcome word over the three files (passes / does not pass / open / not run) is bar_table's reading of the three declared files (make adapted-embedders-bar, the README block); one leg not above zero is enough for 'does not pass'

recipe.data: bench/distill/queries.jsonl.gz and teacher_scores.jsonl.gz as committed by M43, never regenerated; the trainer refuses to run if either file's sha256 differs from its meta; every training id must be in queries.jsonl.gz with split train
recipe.teacher: mixedbread-ai/mxbai-rerank-large-v2 (not re-run): its raw logits, fp32, max_length 512, one per candidate
recipe.list: the fused top 20 of hybrid@bge-small for a synthetic query, plus its source document when it is not among them, in the committed order
recipe.student_score: s * cos(E(q), E(d)): E is the SentenceTransformer forward (Transformer, CLS pooling, Normalize) on the model's own preprocess() output, the path encode() takes, so training and serving cut a long passage at the same token; each unique text is tokenized once; queries and documents bare (no prompt)
recipe.scale: s is fixed per init and training set before training, by a label-free rule: s = std(t_i - t_j) / std(c_i - c_j), numpy std with ddof 0 in float64, pooled over every pair i < j (the list's committed order) of every training list of that training set, t the teacher's logit and c the init model's cosine; recorded with 1/s and the epoch-0 validation loss in bench/distill/embedder_scale.json
recipe.loss: MarginMSE over every pair of one list: the mean over i < j of ((s_i - s_j) - (t_i - t_j))^2, s the student's score and t the teacher's logit (M43's definition); the first step is checked, torch against numpy
recipe.optimizer: AdamW, betas (0.9, 0.999), no weight decay on biases and LayerNorm weights
recipe.schedule: linear warm-up over the first 10% of the steps, then linear decay to zero
recipe.corpus_mixing: each list of a step comes from a corpus drawn with probability proportional to the square root of that corpus's number of training lists; inside a corpus lists are drawn without replacement and reshuffled when exhausted
recipe.precision: float32 throughout: torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 False and float32 matmul precision 'highest'; both, with torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32, recorded in training.json and every results header
recipe.memory: micro_lists (M43) on a GPU under 40 GB, recorded per resume segment: a memory setting, never a hyper-parameter
recipe.validation: the synthetic queries of the held-out source documents (M43's split field): never a gold question, a tune-half question or a BEIR query
recipe.selection: the epoch end (1 to 4) with the lowest macro validation MarginMSE (each corpus's mean list loss, then the mean over the arm's corpora); ties go to the earlier epoch; whether the chosen epoch is the last is recorded; the source document's mean rank inside its validation list is recorded per epoch as a diagnostic and is not used
recipe.seeds: 0 for every arm; 1 and 2 for the bar recipe only, as an exploratory spread

mnrl.formula: cross-entropy over 20 * cos(q, every in-batch candidate), query to document (sentence-transformers 6.1 MultipleNegativesRankingLoss defaults), hand-written so that it can mask
mnrl.lists: only the lists where the teacher ranks the source document first; the source is the positive
mnrl.hard_negative_rule: the teacher's bottom half of the list (the 10 lowest-scored candidates of a 20- or 21-candidate list), the first 7 of those in the list's order
mnrl.batches: all 32 queries from one corpus, the corpus drawn with probability proportional to the square root of its eligible lists; no source document twice in a batch: a list whose source is already in the batch is deferred to that corpus's next batch, never dropped; deferrals counted per epoch
mnrl.mask: for each anchor, every in-batch candidate whose doc id equals the anchor's own positive doc id scores -inf, except the anchor's own positive column; masked entries counted per epoch
mnrl.selection: the epoch end with the lowest masked loss on the validation lists where the teacher ranks the source first, in batches built once with seed 0 (each corpus's mean, then the mean over corpora)
mnrl.hardware: a card of 40 GB or more, no micro-batching; resumed only onto such a card

queries.fields: id, corpus, doc_id, form, query, split

teacher_scores.name: teacher_scores.jsonl.gz
teacher_scores.fields: id, corpus, candidates (fused order, the source appended last when absent), source_rank (1-based in the fused top; null: appended), scores (the teacher's raw logits, one per candidate)

m43.near_duplicate_rule: dropped if normalised-equal, token Jaccard >= 0.7 or bge-small cosine >= 0.90 against any of the 1,084 test queries (M43)

adapted_embedders.tf32_note: torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 is recorded as torch sets it; it governs cuDNN convolutions only, and this encoder has none, so it does not touch these numbers (TF32 also exists only on Ampere and newer cards)
adapted_embedders.llm_judge: no metric uses an LLM judge
adapted_embedders.mnrl_twins: bge-small-mnrl's twin flags are against the all-three query set, a superset of what it trained on: an upper bound
adapted_embedders.mnrl_seen_documents: bge-small-mnrl's BEIR seen-document flags are computed from every training list, a superset of the lists it trained on (those where the teacher ranks the source first): an upper bound
adapted_embedders.load_and_score: every embedder first ranks the check's answer above an unrelated passage with the loaded instance, or the run stops (app/eval/models_2026.py); an adapted one also reproduces its manifest's reference embeddings
adapted_embedders.exploratory: every delta other than the bar row's hybrid delta on the three datasets is descriptive and exploratory
not_shown: not the live host's quality: the host embeds queries with LlamaIndex's bge instruction (compose sets no EMBEDDING_QUERY_INSTRUCTION); every row here embeds bare queries, and nothing here is deployed
not the host's latency: HPC timings are indicative (adapted_embedders_cpu.json); the structural identity is the argument

not transfer to an unseen corpus: the bar row read the documents of all three test corpora in training (unsupervised domain adaptation, as GPL); only the control's fixture rows measure transfer, on one small templated corpus
not re-measurable from a clone: every interval re-scores from the per-query sidecar on a CPU, and nDCG recomputes from the committed TREC runs where they exist, but the checkpoints are not committed

not card-independent on FiQA: rankings are specific to the card they ran on; M41 found that bge-small's own FiQA rankings differ between cards (near-tied documents swapping adjacent places below the top ten, with no metric change); how far an adapted model's rankings move across cards is not measured

not a clean 'what the fixture data added': the control differs from the bar row in its scale s, in its number of training lists (9,396 vs 10,087; 1,175 vs 1,261 steps an epoch) and in its two-corpus square-root-of-size mix; the control-vs-bar delta is confounded by all three
not label-free in the strict sense: the teacher's and bge-small's own training data are unknown and may include these benchmarks' train splits
not GPL itself: gemma4:12b queries, an mxbai-rerank-large-v2 teacher, a cosine model with a fixed scale and about 5k steps
not variance-robust: one run per arm, except the bar recipe, which ran with 3 seeds (0, 1, 2); the bar is read on seed 0 alone
no reranked rows: the served shape has no reranker
no comparison with Qwen3 or harrier except across runs (their rows are in other files, from other runs), so no paired delta
